note: Gujjar Home Class versions. kid / par = homeclass-kid.html KID_VER / homeclass.html PAR_VER, kidApk / parApk = APK versionCode. Every open page checks this every minute and updates itself. Add a news line (k kid|par|all, v = the new version of that kind) with every change, newest first.

news.t: ℹ️ Settings → About & rules: Privacy Policy, Terms, Help, and 🗑 delete my family and data.
📣 After a call you now see "✅ said ready" or "❌ missed". 🤝 Invite a family in Settings.
📱 A new phone now asks you first: Allow or Deny, here on your phone.
👧👦 Each kids phone now shows its own child. Fixed: a change in the parent app could remove a child that was just added on a kids phone.

👋 A new kids phone now shows ONE screen: pick your name or ➕ New child, fill in name, class, 👦 boy / 👧 girl and 🎂 birthday (all needed), Save - ready. The phone is named after the child by itself. ⚙️ Settings shows every child's details directly.
📲 The family code is big on Home until your first child is added; after that it is a small line under Kids devices (more phones: ⚙️ Settings → Devices).
🔢 The top bar shows both versions: the screen (v..) and the Android app (h.. / p..).
📱 The child's "Class phone" list now shows your kids phones, and the device list updates by itself again. 🎂 A date of birth cannot be today or in the future.
🔢 The version shows next to "Home Class" at the top. 📲 The family code is always shown in ⚙️ Settings → Devices too - no button to press.
📲 Your family code is now permanent and always on the Home page - type it on any kids phone, TV or the other parent's phone. 🔁 New code if you ever need to change it.

🗣️ Saying a whole table is now line by line: each line lights up, say it, it turns green and the next one lights up - no button. A line not heard is asked again by voice at once. All lines heard = table learnt, no extra test.
👋 After linking, the kids phone asks once who learns on it - pick your name or add a new child, fill in the class and birthday, Save - all set. This phone then rings for that child's class.
✏️ Children's details moved to ⚙️ Settings - the home page shows only the class.

✏️ My details on the kids phone: name, class, 🎂 birthday and how the app says the name (🔊 Hear it) - with a Save button; Mom and Dad see it too. ⏸ Parents can turn all classes off with one tap. Answers are hands-free by default.
✨ Neater screens: the kids app top bar fits one line (family name and date under the title), and the device buttons in the parent app sit under the device details.
🔄 A refresh button (top bar) in both apps loads the newest version at once. ➕ Adding a child now works on every phone. The voice says "zaa" by default.
👨‍👩‍👧 Other families can use Home Class: start a new family with your family name, ➕ add your children, and 🆘 Report a problem (note + voice note) from Settings. Choose if voice clips may be saved.
🆘 Report a problem (top right): write or record what went wrong - it reaches the Home Class team with the log. The app now shows your family name.
🩺 The TV's log no longer fills up with mic lines, so problems can still be checked later in the day.

📺 TV: everything fits the TV screen now (nothing under the buttons, keys not cut off). The remote's mic falls asleep when no button is pressed - the TV now says "Press OK on the remote" and OK turns the mic on. Spelling on the TV shows the letters popping up like the phone. Any remote button closes the update message.
